overall: The AG found no violation where the Board entered executive session to review an Open Meeting Law complaint, and declined to review a new character-discussion allegation raised only on appeal.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board lacked a proper purpose to enter executive session on July 25, 2016 to discuss an Open Meeting Law complaint filed against it.
allegations.key_passage: However, we have stated in past determinations that a public body may meet in executive session to review Open Meeting Law complaints.

allegations.summary: On review, complainant alleged the Board discussed his character in executive session without notice under G.L. c. 30A, § 21(a)(1); this was not in the original complaint.
allegations.key_passage: Because this allegation was not contained in the original complaint filed with the Board, we decline to review it now.
